Onboarding breaks when: blueprint activates without tier and mode set, Bhudhi call fails silently and user is stuck, or activation fires twice creating duplicate blueprints. This document prevents every one of those failures.
⚖ LAW: A user cannot reach the dashboard until the blueprint is ACTIVE and the first task exists. Onboarding must block at every step until the previous step has a valid backend response.
⚖ LAW: activateBlueprint REQUIRES tier and mode to be set first. The select-blueprint call MUST happen before activate. Never merge these into one call.
On mount: check /api/onboarding/status. If hasActiveBlueprint=true, redirect to /dashboard immediately. Never show onboarding to a user who already has an active blueprint.
Each step is a separate component. The step does not advance until the previous step has a confirmed backend response.
Welcome — confirms user wants to build an execution system — CTA: "Begin"
Goal Input — large textarea — placeholder: "What do you want to achieve?" — required
Purpose + Reality — why this matters + current situation — both required
Timeframe + Commitment — date range or horizon + LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/INTENSE selector
Bhudhi Structuring — loading state while /api/bhudhi/structure-goal runs — shows structured output
Clarification — ONLY shown if missingRequiredFields.length > 0 — ask one field at a time
Blueprint Summary — shows cleanedGoal, purpose, timeframe, commitment, blockers — CTA: "Activate"
Activation — loading state — success routes to /dashboard

⚠ Bhudhi failure must NEVER block the user. Always have a fallback path to manual field entry.
STEP 4 — Step 7: Blueprint Summary + Tier Selection

Show the structured goal summary. Below it: tier selector showing 3 cards — Starter, Growth, Ultimate. User must select a tier. Default: recommend the tier from Erector validation if available, else default to Starter.
On tier select: call /api/onboarding/select-blueprint with { blueprintId, tier, mode: "individual" }. Only after this returns 200 does the Activate button become enabled.
